comparison_kind: retrospective conditional external comparison, not prospective or source-only prediction
anchor_source: Planck2018 base-LambdaCDM CMB+lowE+lensing rounded published central parameters
comparison_data: author cosmic-chronometer catalogue and full covariance recipe; no chronometer parameter fitting or datum removal
radiation: report late-time dust central value and explicit Omega_r in[0,0.0001] correction envelope
covariance: use author-supported correlated systematic recipe with provenance; never silently diagonalize
physical_boundary: capacity-energy architectural term and common metric/stress interpretation explicit; amplitude is calibrated, physical horizon and joint gravity remain separate
planned_source: finite active k-bit register, capacity k log(2), positive geometry-controlled energy epsilon V/k, complete work/phase records and a volume-independent energy control
acceptance: report complete chi-square conditional on fixed anchors and covariance without optimizing targets; do not infer source identification from goodness of fit
primary_covariance_domain: Complete author BC03 table from pinned covariance repository; full covariance construction available for every included row. Complete M11 table is a predeclared stellar-model sensitivity control.
full_catalogue_role: The separately downloaded CC catalogue is retained as provenance/context; no unsupported joint covariance or silently diagonalized full-catalogue likelihood is used.
score_boundary: Pinned OpenWave row28 explicitly forbids fitted Lambda. The calibrated amplitude comparison cannot promote this row; pressure/source and amplitude-free shape consequences are assessed separately.
